title: Handover
logline: On moving day, Maya returns the key to the apartment she shared with Daniel, and turns out to be the buyer he is waiting for.

hook.image: Wide, eye level: an empty sunlit room, pale squares on the white walls; Maya walks out of the dark hallway toward the camera with a key in her fist.

sheet.want: Maya wants the apartment they shared, without telling Daniel why.
sheet.obstacle: Daniel is still there, packing the last box, and he asks.
sheet.twist: Maya is the buyer Daniel is waiting for at six.
sheet.choice: Daniel puts the key in her hand himself.
sheet.cost: He lets go of the place and of his anger in the same move.
sheet.payoff: Maya admits it was never about the apartment.

cliffhanger.last_frame: Medium close-up of Maya from camera C, the key in her closed hand, turning toward the empty doorway after: "I know. I turned down two higher offers."

opened: Why did Daniel choose her offer?

beats.change: she walks into the empty room; he knows she kept a key
the buyers come at six; the key on the island
he asks why she came; a long look at the empty wall
new fact: she is the buyer
new fact: he chose her offer

look.style: Photoreal 35 mm feature film, a quiet European drama, natural skin, deep enough focus to read the room
look.lighting: the sun as the only key, from camera left through two tall bare windows; soft bounce fill from the white walls; no lamps on
look.camera: on sticks, eye level, 35 mm and 50 mm spherical lenses
look.ambience: the room tone of an empty apartment, a faint echo, distant city traffic through closed windows
look.avoid: furniture other than the island and the boxes, warm lamps, lens flares
look.lock: low winter sun from camera left through tall bare windows, hard rectangles of warm light on worn oak floorboards, white walls, cool gray shadows, desaturated warm whites, low contrast, lifted blacks, fine 35 mm grain, still and quiet

tone_refs.take: patient conversations, people small against architecture, soft natural light
cool winter daylight, gray interiors, grief held in still frames
negative space and quiet symmetry, rooms that hold the silence

cinematography.statement: The apartment is empty and so is what is left between them: frame them small, let bare floor, white wall and window light fill most of the frame, and let the room hold the silences
rules: Every wide leaves at least half of the frame empty: floor, wall, window light
Singles sit off-center and look into the empty side of the frame
Locked-off frames; the only move is a very slow push-in on a turn
Two people at most; the conversation is the action

A.desc: on the room's axis at chest height, facing the island and the dark hallway door: the whole room, both of them small, bare floor and wall around them

B.desc: behind Maya's left shoulder, close to the line between them, onto Daniel; her shoulder soft at the left edge

C.desc: behind Daniel's right shoulder, close to the line between them, onto Maya; his shoulder soft at the right edge

shots.action: The empty room in low sun, hard rectangles of window light on the bare floorboards. Maya walks out of the dark hallway door toward the camera and stops at the left end of the island, a key in her fist. Daniel, at the right end, keeps taping the last box and does not look up.
Maya, off-center, the bare white wall beside her, keeps her hands in her coat pockets.

lines.text: You never asked for it back.

shots.action: Daniel finally looks up from the box, the tape still in his hand.
Maya sets the key on the stone island between them. Neither reaches for it. The bare room around them.
shots.sound: the small click of the key on stone

shots.action: Daniel looks at the key, then at her.
Maya looks past him at a pale square on the white wall where a frame used to hang, then back.
Daniel puts the tape down on the box, slowly putting it together.

lines.text: Their agent said the buyer knew the place.
lines.how: slow, quiet, a question he will not ask

shots.action: Maya holds his gaze and, this time, does not look away.
Both of them small in the bare sunlit room, the island and the key between them, neither moving.
Daniel lets out a breath that is almost a laugh and shakes his head once.
Daniel slides the key back across the island, takes Maya's hand and closes her fingers over it.
Daniel lets go of her hand and keeps his eyes on her.

shots.angle: high, from just under the ceiling, looking down
shots.action: From high above, Maya alone by the island with the key in her closed hand while Daniel lifts the last box and walks toward the hallway door. Bare floorboards fill the frame.

lines.how: to herself, almost too quiet to hear

shots.action: Daniel stops in the dark hallway doorway with the box, his back to the room, and does not turn around.

lines.text: I know. I turned down two higher offers.

shots.action: Maya, the key in her closed hand, turns her head toward the empty doorway and holds her breath. Hold on her face.
